summary.title: Dutch researchers calculate green hydrogen costs as low as €7.2/kg
summary.main_point: A study of a 200 MW electrolyzer in the Netherlands found that long-term revenue guarantees are necessary for financial viability, with LCOH ranging from €7.2/kg to €7.7/kg depending on the sourcing configuration.
bullets: The levelized cost of hydrogen was approximately €7.2/kg to €7.3/kg for PPA and hybrid configurations.
Wholesale electricity sourcing resulted in an LCOH of €7.7/kg.
Researchers concluded that all three configurations remain financially unviable without additional support, such as a hydrogen contract for difference.

summary.title: Dos Grados acquires 500MW-plus of solar projects from Akuo in Spain
summary.main_point: Dos Grados has reached an agreement to purchase three solar PV projects from Akuo with a combined capacity exceeding 500MW.
bullets: The acquisition involves three PV solar projects located in Spain.
The total installed capacity of the projects is more than 500MW.

summary.title: BESS industry buzz: optimisation and curtailment in GB
summary.main_point: The latest BESS Industry Buzz highlights ongoing discussions regarding battery energy storage system optimisation, curtailment, and revenue trends across Europe.
bullets: The report covers industry sentiment regarding BESS deal-making and revenue generation.

summary.title: MNRE Adds 402 MW of Solar Cell Capacity to ALMM, Total Nears 38 GW
summary.main_point: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has added 402 MW of solar cell manufacturing capacity to the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) List-II, taking the total enlisted capacity to 37.8 GW.

summary.title: China wafer prices hold steady amid divergent output plans
summary.main_point: China's wafer market prices remained stable ahead of the Golden Week holiday, with producers showing varying production strategies for the fourth quarter.
bullets: FOB China N-type M10 and 210R wafer prices remained unchanged at $0.149/pc and $0.153/pc respectively.
Wafer inventories are estimated at approximately 25 GW.
Some manufacturers are reportedly planning to increase output in October despite a lack of consensus on production cuts.

summary.title: Prices drive Pakistan’s metered solar, outages drive hidden uptake
summary.main_point: A study by researchers from Pakistan and the United Kingdom identifies two distinct solar adoption channels in Pakistan: registered net metering for high-income users and unregistered off-grid systems in areas with poor grid reliability.
bullets: The research combined data from Ember, NEPRA, and Renewables First to analyze solar adoption at the distribution-company level.
Registered net metering is primarily utilized by higher-income customers in well-served utility areas.

summary.title: Batteries beat gas peakers on cost globally
summary.main_point: Wood Mackenzie reports that four-hour battery storage has become cheaper than open-cycle gas turbines across all 43 modeled global markets, though North America faces specific trade and policy challenges.
bullets: Single-axis tracker solar is the lowest-cost new-build power source in 43 of 48 modeled markets.
North American energy storage investment is being supported by data center demand and rising peaking costs.

summary.title: Thermal energy storage delivers industrial heat and grid solutions
summary.main_point: Thermal energy storage systems are being positioned to reduce industrial reliance on natural gas while offering potential solutions for renewable energy curtailment.
bullets: A September 2026 IEA report suggested a 35% global electrification target by 2035 is within reach using existing technologies.
MGA Thermal is developing electro-thermal energy storage systems to manage industrial loads and grid issues.

summary.title: Voltus raises $225 million for demand flexibility portfolio
summary.main_point: Virtual power plant operator Voltus raised $225 million in a Series D funding round to support its goal of building a 20 GW demand flexibility portfolio.
bullets: The funding round was led by Generation Investment Management, with Activate Capital and Vitol as co-leads.
Voltus enrolls distributed energy resource owners to help grid operators meet peak demand.
The North American Electric Reliability Corporation estimates a need for over 270 gigawatts of new peak capacity.

summary.title: Austria receives 43,300 solar subsidy applications in ten minutes
summary.main_point: Austria's final funding round for photovoltaic and battery storage systems saw 43,300 applications submitted within the first 10 minutes of the portal opening.
bullets: The Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs, Energy and Tourism reported that demand exceeded the second funding round, which saw 24,900 tickets in the first 10 minutes.
The government is reconsidering its subsidy approach following the high demand and recent consultations.

summary.title: Sunbooster secures European patent for bifacial photovoltaic fences
summary.main_point: Austrian company Sunbooster has patented a vertical bifacial photovoltaic fence solution now protected in 18 European Union member states.
bullets: The system uses 18.6 cm-high bifacial strips with a conversion efficiency of 22.8%.
Strips are rated at 62 W for a 2-meter length or 79 W for a 2.5-meter length.
The company is targeting expansion in the French market, where it has completed its first installation.

summary.title: Italy faces grid connection requests exceeding 300 GW
summary.main_point: Renewable energy connection requests in Italy have reached over 300 GW, significantly higher than the capacity planned for 2030.
bullets: Since September, grid access is granted based on who obtains authorization first rather than the order of application.

summary.title: NTPC tenders solar and storage projects while POWERGRID commissions transmission line
summary.main_point: POWERGRID has commissioned a transmission project for a 2,500 MW solar zone in Karnataka, while NTPC has issued tenders for a 1 GW solar project and a 3,300 MWh BESS.
bullets: POWERGRID commissioned the Bidar, Karnataka project on October 5, 2026.
NTPC Renewable Energy Ltd is seeking EPC services for a 1 GW ground-mounted solar project in Andhra Pradesh.
NTPC Green Energy Ltd is seeking an EPC package for a 3,300 MWh battery energy storage system at the Khavda solar plant in Gujarat.

summary.title: India adds 402 MW of solar cell capacity to ALMM list
summary.main_point: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has updated its Approved List of Models and Manufacturers, bringing total enlisted solar cell capacity to 37.8 GW.
bullets: The 12th revision of the list was issued on 8 October 2026 (PV Tech).

summary.title: Beyond gigawatts: Why India’s clean energy future depends on storage intelligence
summary.main_point: For decades, the success of India’s renewable energy transition has largely been measured in gigawatts.

summary.title: Majority of U.S. solar manufacturing expansion plans lack financing
summary.main_point: Over 70% of announced U.S. solar manufacturing expansion plans have not yet been financed, according to the Solar Manufacturing USA Quarterly report.
bullets: Solar PV manufacturing capital expenditure is forecast to decline year-on-year in 2027 compared to 2026 figures of approximately $3 billion.

summary.title: Poly pricing and potential expansion
summary.main_point: Recent industry checks in the United States suggest that an increase in US minimum import prices (MIPs) under the polysilicon Section 232 framework may not occur until after Dec.

summary.title: Clearway begins construction on 650 MW Swan Energy Center
summary.main_point: Clearway Energy Group has closed financing and commenced construction on the 650 MW Swan Energy Center in Bates County, Missouri.
bullets: Construction is expected to continue through the middle of 2028.
The project site will employ up to 500 workers during the construction period.

summary.title: Can Beijing end the race to the bottom?
summary.main_point: China’s solar industry has spent two decades proving how far costs can fall.

summary.title: Voltage Energy targets European utility-scale solar market with eBOS solutions
summary.main_point: Voltage Energy is focusing on the European market with a strategic approach to eBOS that differs from traditional methods.
bullets: Ruiyan Ge, President of Voltage Energy, stated the company is targeting growth in Europe's utility-scale solar sector.

summary.title: France proposes framework for long-term capacity auctions
summary.main_point: The French Energy Regulatory Commission has proposed a new capacity mechanism involving long-term and short-term auctions to prevent supply shortages.
bullets: The mechanism compensates operators of generation, storage, and demand-response assets for availability during critical periods.
Long-term auctions are planned for approximately four years before the delivery period, with the first covering the winter of 2030-31.
A short-term auction took place on July 6, 2026, for the winter of 2026-27.

summary.title: French solar tender prices decline in latest rounds
summary.main_point: Minister delegate for energy Maud Bregeon announced price drops in recent French solar tenders, though official regulatory data is pending.
bullets: The tender for ground-mounted PV projects awarded 930 MW of capacity across 125 projects.
The weighted average price for ground-mounted projects fell to €60 ($67.40)/MWh from approximately €80/MWh in the previous round.
Average prices for smaller PV installations ranging from 100 kW to 500 kW fell to €75/MWh.

summary.title: Oswal Pumps and Premier Energies announce solar manufacturing and order updates
summary.main_point: Oswal Pumps plans a 1.2 GW solar cell facility, while Premier Energies reported significant order growth and manufacturing capacity increases.
bullets: Oswal Pumps announced plans to establish a 1.2 GW solar cell facility.
Premier Energies Ltd secured INR 4,001 crore in orders during the July–Sep. quarter of FY27 for 2,308 MW of solar cells, modules, and EPC projects.
Premier Energies' total module manufacturing capacity reached 11.1 GW, and solar cell capacity increased to 10.6 GW following a new 7 GW facility commissioning.

summary.title: Solis reaches 10 GW shipment milestone in India and expands storage
summary.main_point: Solis has hit 10 GW in cumulative shipments in India and is expanding its energy storage business.
bullets: Solis recorded global revenue of $572 million in the first half of 2026, with 60.3% from overseas markets.
Energy storage inverter revenue grew by 106.7% year on year, and R&D investment reached $37.7 million.
The Chennai Port Authority has invited bids for a grid-connected solar project with battery energy storage under the RESCO model.

summary.title: India clarifies customs duty for battery energy storage systems
summary.main_point: The Ministry of Finance confirmed that stationary, grid-scale, and industrial lithium-ion battery energy storage systems qualify for a 10% basic customs duty.
bullets: The 10% rate is a concessional basic customs duty.

summary.title: September/October 2026 issue: Preparing for tomorrow’s solar and storage trends
summary.main_point: I’ve been staying inside a lot more this year because the weather in Pennsylvania has been mercurial.

summary.title: Premier Energies reports Q2 FY2027 order value
summary.main_point: Premier Energies secured orders totaling INR 40.01 billion during the July–September 2026 period.
bullets: The order value is equivalent to US$419 million.
Orders include solar cell and module supply as well as EPC contracts.

summary.title: Voltus raises US$225 million for VPP expansion
summary.main_point: Distributed energy resource platform Voltus secured US$225 million in Series D funding to expand its virtual power plant services.
bullets: The funding round was oversubscribed.
The company plans to expand its operations in the US and Canada.

summary.title: BESS industry experts discuss long-term service agreements
summary.main_point: A panel of industry experts discussed the requirements and challenges of long-term service agreements for battery energy storage systems at a summit in the UK and Ireland.
bullets: The discussion took place at the Battery Asset Management Summit UK & Ireland 2026.

summary.title: Mercedes-Benz introduces bidirectional charging in Germany
summary.main_point: Mercedes-Benz has launched a bidirectional charging service in Germany that allows electric vehicle owners to participate in the electricity market.
bullets: The MB.Charge Home Pro Intelligent package includes an 11 kW bidirectional DC wallbox priced at €2,990.
Customers receive a payment of €0.1175 per hour while their vehicle is connected to the wallbox.
The wallbox was developed by The Mobility House in partnership with EcoG and Zhejiang EV-Tech.

summary.title: Heliup and Holcim launch lightweight rooftop solar solution
summary.main_point: Heliup and Holcim have partnered to offer a lightweight solar system that combines PV modules with a waterproofing membrane for flat roofs.
bullets: The Solar Light TPO system weighs 7 kg/m², compared to 15 kg/m² to 20 kg/m² for conventional systems.
The solution uses a mounting method that requires no roof penetrations, additional rails, or ballast.
The waterproofing membrane is available in thicknesses ranging from 1.5 mm to 2 mm.

summary.title: NVVN invites bids for rooftop solar project in Chandigarh
summary.main_point: NTPC Vidyut Vyapar Nigam has issued a tender for a 1.89 MW rooftop solar project at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research.
bullets: The project scope includes design, engineering, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and 10 years of operation and maintenance services.

summary.title: Telangana issues tender for firm renewable power supply
summary.main_point: The Telangana Power Generation Corporation has invited bids to supply firm and dispatchable renewable energy from projects equipped with energy storage.
bullets: The projects are to be located at Shankar Pally and Ramagundam.

summary.title: India's digital economy growth and industrial transformation
summary.main_point: India's digital economy accounted for 11.74% of national income in 2022–23 and is expected to reach nearly one fifth by 2030.
bullets: The digital economy's contribution in 2022–23 was equivalent to approximately INR 31.64 lakh crore.
Digital infrastructure is increasingly integrated into the foundation of energy, manufacturing, and industrial services.

summary.title: EcoFlow releases Titan series residential energy storage systems
summary.main_point: EcoFlow has launched the Titan series of residential battery storage systems, which are scalable from 5 kWh to 30 kWh.
bullets: The series includes the Titan 5000, Titan 5000 Plus, and Titan 5000 Classic models.
The Titan 5000 Plus delivers 7.2 kW of output from a 5-kWh battery (Solar Power World).
EcoFlow stated that 80% of 100,000 households analyzed stayed below a power demand of 6.7 kW for 99% of the time (pv magazine).

summary.title: Unico launches 330kW bidirectional grid-tie inverter
summary.main_point: Unico has introduced a 330kW bidirectional grid-tie inverter designed for solar generation, energy storage, and high-power loads.
bullets: The inverter operates at 98.5% efficiency and features a power density of 72W per cubic inch.
It supports AC voltages from 380 to 900 VAC and a programmable DC voltage range from 600 to 1500 VDC.
The platform allows for parallel operation in groups of ten or more units.

summary.title: Tigo Energy releases guide for solar repowering market
summary.main_point: Tigo Energy has published a manual to assist solar contractors in transitioning to service and modernization models for aging photovoltaic systems.
bullets: The guide, titled Repowering Business Playbook, addresses the demand for replacing aging hardware such as string inverters and monitoring equipment.

summary.title: Finland mandates grid-forming control for new large wind and solar plants
summary.main_point: Fingrid has introduced new technical requirements under its VJV2024 grid code for large wind and solar plants connecting to weak parts of the network.
bullets: The requirements apply to type D plants connecting where the equivalent short-circuit ratio is below 1.0.
Existing plants and projects with established connection agreements are exempt from the new rules.
Grid-forming control must be provided via the plant's own inverters or separate equipment built at or near the site.

summary.title: Poland identified as a top market for energy storage profitability
summary.main_point: Industry experts report that energy storage systems in Poland currently offer exceptionally high returns compared to other European markets.
bullets: Maxxen CEO Ruben Valiente stated that battery storage returns in Poland are currently very high but expects them to decrease as more large-scale projects enter the market.
Clean Horizon consultant Salome Perperot noted that two-hour energy storage systems in Poland achieved the highest revenues among the countries studied by the firm this year.

summary.title: Researchers study moth-eye-inspired surfaces for solar module durability
summary.main_point: Scientists in Portugal are investigating how antireflective nanostructures on silicon surfaces withstand mechanical stress and environmental challenges.
bullets: The study focuses on the friction and wear behavior of these structures to determine their suitability for integration into the outer surfaces of photovoltaic modules.
Researchers aim to understand how the morphology of these nanostructures evolves under repeated mechanical loading and cleaning operations.

summary.title: US solar industry faces trade duties and workforce readiness challenges
summary.main_point: The US has ruled that solar imports from India, Indonesia, and Laos harmed domestic manufacturers, while India's own solar sector reports a significant workforce skills gap.
bullets: The US International Trade Commission determined that crystalline silicon PV cell imports from India, Indonesia, and Laos caused material injury to the domestic industry (Mercom India).
A Mercom India survey of over 100 industry participants found that fresh graduates in India require substantial training to meet the needs of the solar sector (pv magazine).

summary.title: Oswal Pumps to establish 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell facility in India
summary.main_point: Oswal Pumps Ltd plans to build a 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing plant to support its in-house module production.
bullets: The facility will be developed by the company's subsidiary, Oswal Solar Energy Pvt Ltd.
Commercial production at the new site is expected to commence by April 2028.
The output is intended for captive consumption to secure supply and reduce exposure to market price volatility.

summary.title: Odisha requires significant investment for renewable energy and infrastructure expansion
summary.main_point: A new IEEFA report estimates that Odisha needs approximately INR 1.1 lakh crore to scale up renewable energy and grid infrastructure over the next decade.
bullets: The state aims to add 10.7 GW of renewable energy capacity between financial year 2025–2026 and financial year 2035–2036.
The total investment requirement is estimated at INR 1,09,980 crore, or nearly INR 1.1 lakh crore.

summary.title: ARENA launches third round of Solar Sunshot funding
summary.main_point: The Australian Renewable Energy Agency has opened a new funding round offering up to AU$250 million for large-scale solar PV manufacturing and demonstration.
bullets: The funding is available to companies that manufacture or demonstrate equipment for building large-scale solar PV power plants in Australia.
The AU$250 million figure is equivalent to US$175 million.

summary.title: Illinois school district invests in solar on three school buildings
summary.main_point: Allied Facility Partners, a design-build and performance contracting firm serving K-12, municipal and public-sector organizations across Illinois and Wisconsin, has completed a districtwide rooftop solar project for Cary Community Consolidated School District 26 in Illinois.

summary.title: Ameresco completes solar-plus-storage project for Oregon wastewater site
summary.main_point: A $1 million solar-plus-storage project has been completed at the Roseburg Urban Sanitary Authority office in Oregon.
bullets: The system is designed to meet 100% of the energy needs for the site.
This project marks the first phase of a multi-phase energy program intended to improve facility resilience and sustainability.

summary.title: Ampyr Solar Europe and international investors announce solar project stake sales
summary.main_point: Ampyr Solar Europe sold a 49% stake in a 157 MW German project, while Norfund and Impact Fund Denmark acquired a 49% interest in a 500 MWp project in the Philippines.
bullets: Ampyr Solar Europe sold a 49% stake in its 157 MW Elsterheide solar project (Mercom India).
Norfund and Impact Fund Denmark signed agreements to acquire a 49% interest in the 500 MWp Ixus Bugallon Solar Power Project in the Philippines (PV Tech).

summary.title: France announces measures to improve grid flexibility and reduce energy costs
summary.main_point: The French government is introducing initiatives to improve residential energy management and EV charging flexibility, aiming to reduce energy costs by up to 35%.
bullets: Subsidies for heat pumps will be conditional on smart-control capabilities starting in 2027 (pv magazine).
Households installing smart-control systems could save between €150 ($168.8) and €200 annually (pv magazine).
The government plans to ensure smart-control functions are enabled by default in new EV charging infrastructure (pv magazine).

summary.title: Study links reduced maintenance to performance decline at Algerian solar plant
summary.main_point: A six-year assessment of a 12 MW solar plant in Algeria found that performance dropped in 2020 due to maintenance restrictions during the COVID-19 pandemic.
bullets: The study covered the period from 2018 to 2023 at a 12 MW plant in Sidi Bel-Abbes (pv magazine).
The facility uses 47,808 Hanwha Qcells polycrystalline modules and SMA Sunny Central 800CP XT inverters (pv magazine).

summary.title: GRIDCO invites bids for floating solar and battery storage project consultancy
summary.main_point: GRIDCO is seeking a consultant to evaluate the environmental and social impacts of the Upper Indravati floating solar and battery energy storage project.
bullets: The scope of work includes assessing evacuation infrastructure and associated transmission lines (Mercom India).

summary.title: NTPC Renewable Energy seeks bids for solar projects in Maharashtra
summary.main_point: NTPC Renewable Energy has issued a tender for the engineering, procurement, and construction of solar projects near its Dhule Solar Project.
bullets: The projects are intended to be interstate transmission system-connected (Mercom India).

summary.title: China TOPCon solar cell prices decline following Golden Week
summary.main_point: Prices for TOPCon solar cells in China fell following the Golden Week holiday as the industry faces weakening overseas demand.
bullets: FOB China TOPCon M10 cell prices fell 0.86% to $0.0463/W, while 210R cell prices fell 0.66% to $0.0454/W (pv magazine India).
Both formats are approximately 13% below their late-August peaks (pv magazine India).

summary.title: Qcells to introduce U.S. domestic frames for residential solar panel lineup
summary.main_point: Qcells announced plans to launch new versions of its residential solar panel series featuring U.S.-made aluminum frames by the end of 2026.

summary.title: Energy storage projects reach financial and operational milestones in US
summary.main_point: Flatiron Energy secured $850 million for a Massachusetts storage project, while Nightpeak Energy brought the second phase of a Texas battery system online.
bullets: Flatiron Energy closed approximately US$850 million for the 1,200MWh Energizar project in Chelsea, Massachusetts (Energy-Storage.news).
Nightpeak Energy’s 150 MW / 300 MWh Bocanova 2 project in Texas reached commercial operation on September 17, bringing the site's total capacity to 300 MW / 600 MWh (pv magazine USA).

summary.title: Patent lawsuit reveals equipment imports for Tesla solar factory
summary.main_point: A federal patent lawsuit indicates that Tesla is importing Chinese crystal-pulling equipment for a 10 GW solar production line at its Texas gigafactory.
bullets: Linton Crystal Technologies filed a patent infringement complaint against Chinese manufacturer Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical and Electrical (pv magazine USA).
The legal dispute involves Czochralski crystal pullers intended for the $10.1 billion solar factory in Fort Bend County (pv magazine USA).

summary.title: Spanish researchers test low-height agrivoltaics in vineyards
summary.main_point: A research team in Spain has experimentally tested the integration of low-height photovoltaic systems within vineyards to assess their agricultural and energy performance.
bullets: The systems are positioned closer to the ground between vine rows to reduce structural material requirements, installation costs, and visual impact.
Researchers tested three agrivoltaic systems at commercial vineyards in southeastern Spain during the 2024 harvest season.
The design aims to minimize interference with vineyard machinery and routine agricultural operations while limiting shading during critical grape development stages.

summary.title: Dutch regulator warns of cyber risks to grid stability from cloud-controlled devices
summary.main_point: The Dutch Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur warns that cyberattacks or faulty updates on cloud platforms could destabilize the grid by simultaneously controlling large numbers of home energy devices.
bullets: The regulator states that a sudden supply and demand imbalance of 3 GW or more can disrupt the grid.
The Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur argues that the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2 directive only partially cover the companies managing these platforms.
The primary risk identified is the backend systems of manufacturers, aggregators, and energy management providers, which act as a single point of entry for large groups of devices.

summary.title: Epyr raises €15 million for industrial thermal energy storage expansion
summary.main_point: France-based thermal energy storage provider Epyr has secured €15 million in an oversubscribed Series A funding round.
bullets: The funding round is equivalent to approximately $17 million (Mercom India).

summary.title: Norwegian politicians propose legalizing plug-in solar and batteries
summary.main_point: Members of the Green Party in Norway have proposed removing restrictions on plug-in solar and battery systems to benefit consumers and landlords.
bullets: The proposal aims to remove bureaucratic obstacles and taxes on clean energy production (pv magazine).

summary.title: Study suggests renewable energy expansion benefits oil-exporting nations
summary.main_point: Researchers at LUT University in Finland found that oil-dependent countries can increase export revenues by replacing domestic fossil fuel consumption with renewable electricity.
bullets: Norway is cited as a successful example of combining oil and gas production with extensive renewable energy generation (pv magazine).

summary.title: Chennai Port Authority and ACME Solar announce new energy projects
summary.main_point: Chennai Port Authority has invited bids for a rooftop solar project, while ACME Solar signed a power procurement agreement for a 300 MW/1,200 MWh dispatchable energy project.
bullets: Chennai Port Authority is seeking a grid-connected rooftop solar project under the RESCO model (Mercom India).
ACME Solar's project will supply 4 MWh per MW of contracted capacity for four hours daily during non-solar hours (pv magazine India).
The ACME Solar project tariff is INR 6/kWh (pv magazine India).

summary.title: ACME Solar signs 300 MW dispatchable renewable energy agreement
summary.main_point: ACME Solar has signed a power procurement agreement with the Solar Energy Corporation of India for a 300 MW/1,200 MWh firm and dispatchable renewable energy project.
bullets: The project was secured at a tariff of INR 6 ($0.063)/kWh (pv magazine).
The agreement requires a minimum monthly availability of 90% (pv magazine).

summary.title: Trontek to launch 5 MWh liquid-cooled battery storage system
summary.main_point: Trontek Electronics will debut its 5 MWh EKOM containerized battery energy storage system at The Battery Show India 2026.
bullets: The system features lithium iron phosphate cells, liquid cooling, and a cycle life exceeding 9,000 cycles (pv magazine India).
The design aims for a system efficiency of over 93% (pv magazine India).

summary.title: JinkoSolar unveils 510-W all-black residential solar module
summary.main_point: JinkoSolar has introduced the Tiger Neo 5.0 residential module, which utilizes a combination of TOPCon and HJT technologies.
bullets: The 48-cell module offers a maximum power output of 510 W and 25.52% efficiency (Solar Power World).

summary.title: Duke Energy Florida completes 75-MW Bailey Mill solar site
summary.main_point: Duke Energy Florida has finished construction on the 74.9-MW Bailey Mill Solar Center in Jefferson County.
bullets: The project is intended to help lower long-term energy costs for customers (Solar Power World).

summary.title: US battery storage sector faces year-end commissioning challenges
summary.main_point: The US battery energy storage system sector is experiencing recurring difficulties related to commissioning and policy during the year-end period.
bullets: The year-end rush is described as a perennial challenge for the industry (Energy-Storage.news).
